title: RoleCompatibilityProfile
description: SUPERSEDED AS AN AUTHORING SURFACE (Revision 2). HR no longer hand-authors this profile. The equivalent parameterization — dimensions, weights, mandatory gates, required evidence, confidence floors — is now DERIVED by the Hiring Policy Compiler (PWC) from a declarative Hiring Policy (hiring_policy_source.schema.json) and emitted into the signed HiringWorkflowIR (hiring_workflow_ir.schema.json). This schema is retained as the shape of the compiler's compiled dimension model for reference and backward compatibility; it is not authored directly. There is NO universal weighting model. Weights shape only the analytics-only Overall Fit Index and never gate eligibility and never enter the Decision Authority.

version.description: Immutable once PUBLISHED; a change is a new version.

dimensions.description: Role-scoped compatibility axes selected for this role. NOT a fixed universal set.

dimension_weights.description: Weights over this role's dimensions. MUST sum to 1.0 (within tolerance). Advisory only: feeds the non-binding Overall Fit Index; never gates.

mandatory_gate_refs.description: References into the gate catalog. Non-compensatory; evaluated by the Decision Authority. See mandatory_gate.schema.json.

required_evidence.description: Per dimension, evidence types that must be ADMITTED before the dimension may be scored at all.

minimum_confidence.description: Per dimension confidence floor in [0,1]. Below the floor the dimension reports INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE instead of a score.
